newsitem.title: UK: UK regulator reviewing GWR purchase of Classic FM.
newsitem.headline: UK regulator reviewing GWR purchase of Classic FM.

text.p: Britain's Director General of Fair Trading on Thursday said he is considering whether the proposed acquisition of Classic FM Plc by GWR Group Plc should be investigated under merger provisions of the Fair Trading Act 1973.

If the deal is found to qualify for investigation, the Director General said he will consider it further with a view to advising the Secretary for Trade and Industry whether the merger should be referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
